title: GFG: Kth Smallest Element
description: Given an array `arr` and a number `k` where `k` is smaller than the size of the array, find the `k`th smallest element in the given array.
constraints:
1 <= len(arr) <= 10^5, 1 <= k <= len(arr)
• Time: O(N log K) | Space: O(K)
starter_code:
def kth_smallest(arr: list[int], k: int) -> int:
    pass
solution:
def kth_smallest(arr: list[int], k: int) -> int:
    return sorted(arr)[k - 1]
explanation: Sorting or max-heap finds kth smallest in O(N log N) time.
